name: Flash-Next raw-gate-plus-inject Metal candidate
adaptation: The upstream Vulkan fusion was used only as a design input; no GLSL or C++ implementation was copied.
The mlx2 candidate is an original MLX Metal kernel owned by the Qwen4 adapter and remains default-off.
It accepts the raw four-value projection and fuses divide-by-four, precise sigmoid, multiply-by-two, stream broadcast, branch multiply, and residual add.
Admission is locked to BF16 Flash-Next geometry and the ordinary MLX graph is retained as a fail-closed fallback.
Diagnostics distinguish calls and declines; implemented, qualified, selected, and observed-used remain separate states.

preimplementation_observation.method: LLDB breakpoints on AGXG17XFamilyComputeContext dispatch selectors, after warm-up and around one isolated evaluation

validation.claims: The bounded kernel and model checks passed, and isolated physical engagement was observed. Full serving-route qualification, default selection, and stable performance claims remain explicitly out of scope.
